parts.text: $SN Q3 2026: revenue $2.0B, +21% Y/Y, driven by growth across cleaning, cooking, and beverage appliances. Operating margin 22.4%; net earnings $338M. #earnings #consumer
$APC Q3 2026: revenue $1.9B, +27% Y/Y, driven by Fuel Products growing 34% as the largest segment. Operating margin 1.3%; operating cash flow $22M. #earnings #industrials

$CF Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.9B, +12% Y/Y, driven by higher North American demand and higher average selling prices for ammonia. Operating margin 37.7%; operating cash flow $1.2B. #earnings #materials
$UHAL Q2 FY27: revenue $1.8B, +3% Y/Y, driven by gains in self-moving equipment rental and self-storage revenues amid capacity expansion. Operating margin 15.0%. #earnings #EarningsSeason
$UFPI Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +11% Y/Y, while operating profit fell to a 4.0% margin as costs grew faster than sales. Net earnings $59M; operating cash flow $174M. #earnings #materials

$SNAP Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.7B, +14% Y/Y, reflecting progress toward profitability as AI enhanced advertising and operations. Operating margin 4.5%; operating cash flow $210M. #earnings #tech
$TPC Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +22% Y/Y, driven by project execution activities on newer, larger and higher-margin projects. Operating margin 7.3%; operating cash flow $331M. #earnings #industrials
$EW Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +10% Y/Y, driven by higher sales of TAVR and TMTT products. Operating margin 17.4%; operating cash flow $570M. #earnings #medtech
$AMC Q3 2026: revenue reached $1.7B, up 32% Y/Y, driven by admissions growth. Operating margin was 14.5%. #earnings #streaming
$CHRD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.7B, +30% Y/Y, driven by oil volumes above guidance and strong realizations. Operating margin 29.6%; operating cash flow $781M. #earnings #oil

$ARDT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +3% Y/Y, driven by a 2.9% increase in adjusted admissions. Operating margin 5.0%; net earnings $45M. Guides FY26 revenue to $6.4B–$6.7B. #earnings #healthcare
$STE Q2 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +9% Y/Y, driven by strong Life Sciences performance and solid healthcare demand. Operating margin was 18.5%. #earnings #medtech
